name: Memory Usage
query:
SELECT
    `tabAI Memory`.name AS "Memory ID:Data:140",
    `tabAI Memory`.content AS "Content:Long Text:300",
    `tabAI Memory`.memory_type AS "Type:Data:100",
    `tabAI Memory`.scope AS "Scope:Data:80",
    `tabAI Memory`.scope_value AS "Scope Value:Data:120",
    `tabAI Memory`.status AS "Status:Data:70",
    `tabAI Memory`.usage_count AS "Used:Int:60",
    `tabAI Memory`.helpful_count AS "Helpful:Int:60",
    `tabAI Memory`.not_helpful_count AS "Not Helpful:Int:70",
    `tabAI Memory`.confidence AS "Confidence:%:70",
    `tabAI Memory`.embedding_dimensions AS "Embed Dims:Int:70",
    `tabAI Memory`.embedding_model AS "Embed Model:Data:120",
    `tabAI Memory`.last_used_on AS "Last Used:Datetime:150",
    `tabAI Memory`.creation AS "Created:Datetime:150"
FROM
    `tabAI Memory`
ORDER BY
    `tabAI Memory`.usage_count DESC, `tabAI Memory`.last_used_on DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 500
